lead_html: Romanian Hijaz sits on E harmonic minor, so the i chord is E minor and the raised D# gives you a bright B major. Start with the three cards below, then move on.
alias_html: Also written E Hijaz or E Romanian Hijaz.
history_html: Hijaz is a scale family with roots in the Arabic maqamat, as Isthmus Instruments puts it. The Romanian version starts on the fourth degree of the Hijaz scale. On E that gives E F# G A B C D#, which is E harmonic minor. The raised seventh, D#, is what makes a major chord on B possible.
MAG Instruments calls it the most popular Hijaz variant and says it sounds exotic and Middle Eastern. Isthmus Instruments says it was an early handpan scale that has stayed on many makers' lists.
og_description: E Romanian Hijaz 9 handpan chords: the chord cards with the notes to play, then practice in the free chord flashcard app.
